title: Lost Time
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to lose 2 AC and the ability to take reactions for 50 turns.

fields.Inspiration: Drinking grants An Acquired Taste to Guild Artisan party members.
fields.Acquisition: Acrid Workshop in the Overgrown Tunnel or the hag’s basement under the Blushing Mermaid.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
